candidate.educational_objective: Teach safe fluid administration and choking precautions for psyllium.

options.A: Take each dose with adequate fluid because psyllium can swell and obstruct the throat or esophagus if taken without enough liquid.
options.B: Swallow the dry powder without water so it works faster.
options.C: Use psyllium despite difficulty swallowing because fluid is unnecessary.
options.D: If chest pain or difficulty swallowing develops, continue taking the product until the next scheduled visit.

candidate.rationale: Psyllium is a bulk-forming laxative. Current OTC labeling carries a choking warning: without adequate fluid, the product can swell and block the throat or esophagus. Clients with difficulty swallowing should not use it, and chest pain, vomiting, or difficulty swallowing or breathing after a dose requires immediate medical attention.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Psyllium requires adequate fluid because it can swell and cause esophageal/throat obstruction and choking.
